scripts.build: node scripts/clean-static-export.mjs && next build && node scripts/copy-public-assets.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts next.config.ts eslint.config.mjs postcss.config.mjs
scripts.sync:data: python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project equal-love && npm run generate:share-validation
scripts.sync:data:equal-love: python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project equal-love && npm run generate:share-validation
scripts.sync:data:nearly-equal-joy: python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project nearly-equal-joy && npm run generate:share-validation
scripts.sync:data:not-equal-me: python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project not-equal-me && npm run generate:share-validation
scripts.sync:data:all: python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project equal-love && python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project nearly-equal-joy && python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project not-equal-me && npm run generate:share-validation
scripts.sync:songs:equal-love: python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project equal-love --songs-only && npm run generate:share-validation
scripts.sync:songs:nearly-equal-joy: python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project nearly-equal-joy --songs-only && npm run generate:share-validation
scripts.sync:songs:not-equal-me: python scripts/sync-project-discography.py --project not-equal-me --songs-only && npm run generate:share-validation

scripts.test: npm run test:discography && npm run test:board-state && npm run test:song-search && npm run test:pick-reordering && npm run test:share-links && npm run test:export-presets && npm run test:export-board && npm run test:pick-assistant && npm run test:image-actions && npm run test:orchestrator && npm run test:current-project-runtime && npm run test:archetype-labeler && npm run test:archetype-affinity && npm run test:archetype-ui
scripts.verify:static-export: node scripts/run-project-command.mjs equal-love build-and-verify && node scripts/run-project-command.mjs nearly-equal-joy build-and-verify && node scripts/run-project-command.mjs not-equal-me build-and-verify
scripts.verify: npm run check:repo-boundary && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run validate:data && npm test && npm run verify:static-export
